note: Small sample of the big BCV-indexed resource library the wizard filters against. Real library is expected to hold thousands of entries, lazily loaded/paginated by language+mediaType+bcvRange. Entries below now carry an optional 'groundedIn' block sourced via the bible-tool-navigator MCP server (Bible Tool Navigator curated set / global inventory) where a real tool or dataset was found to back that entry - deliberately kept to a handful of representative entries, not a dump of the full datasets (~53 curated, 261 inventory). 'groundedIn.rightsPosture'/'licensePosture' are postures to verify with the named rights holder, never a grant to use. 'relevantModules' is wiring metadata (not from the Navigator) so the app can filter this catalog by the module cart step in modules.json.
